ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the process shown in the diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the picture is a green flowering plant, with its roots in the soil; in the upper left there is the sun and light rays shining toward the plant; in the soil near the roots there is moisture; there are arrows pointing toward the leaves, and there are also arrows going outward from near the leaves. Reasoning: The question asks the name of the process shown in the picture. Plants use sunlight, water absorbed by the roots, and carbon dioxide in the air to make food, and release oxygen; this whole process is called photosynthesis. Therefore this picture represents basic photosynthesis.
